description: Calculated on Train + Validation sets (80% of clean data) to prevent data snooping on the held-out Test Set.
decision_rationale: At MAX_LENGTH=128, 96.07% of samples are fully preserved (p95 is 121 tokens). Truncation is only 3.93%. Quadratic attention cost O(L^2) and activation memory fit comfortably within 8GB VRAM (RTX 5050 / Colab T4) without OOM risk, whereas 256 would quadruple attention operations for a marginal 3.84% coverage gain.
